description:
Create, list, print, copy, delete and render notes. A note is identified by its stem: the filename without .md, e.g. 2026-09-10-14-30-00. Subcommands: new --type TYPE --topic TOPIC --thread THREAD [--person P] [--counterparty C] [--location L] — create a note; print its absolute path list [FILTER] [--json] — list notes oldest first: stem, date, type, threads, topic cat STEM — print a note last — print the path of the newest note copy STEM — copy a note to a new timestamp; its topic gets ' COPY' appended delete STEM -y — permanently delete a note pdf STEM [--out DIR] — render to .md and .md.pdf, with callouts and an action table; print both paths minutes STEM [--out DIR] — render meeting minutes: agreements, resolutions, action items agenda STEM [--out DIR] — render a meeting agenda: the note with its outcome sections emptied Args: STEM note stem, e.g. 2026-09-10-14-30-00. Get it from `list` or `search notes`. FILTER case-insensitive text matched against any column Flags: new: --type TYPE required. One of: Meeting, Correspondence, Workshop, Report, Log, Research, Recipe --topic TOPIC required, non-empty --thread THREAD required. Thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink. Repeatable. --person P Meeting and Correspondence only. An attendee; repeatable. Linked if people/

.md exists. --counterparty C Meeting only --location L Meeting only delete: -y, --yes required to confirm pdf / minutes / agenda: --out DIR output directory (default: the user's Downloads folder) Examples: ["new", "--type", "Meeting", "--topic", "Quarterly review", "--thread", "Projects/SGB", "--person", "Riaz Arbi", "--location", "Cape Town"] ["list", "sgb", "--json"] ["cat", "2026-09-10-14-30-00"] ["minutes", "2026-09-10-14-30-00", "--out", "out"] Notes: Nothing prompts. delete is destructive and refuses to run without -y. Every subcommand except new first ingests ACTION: lines into TASK: anchors, which rewrites note and log files in place. new also queues a REF: in the buffer. It reaches the thread's daily log on the next `buffer flush`. pdf, minutes and agenda need pandoc and xelatex. Exit 1: bad or unknown stem, empty --topic, --person/--counterparty/--location on the wrong note type, or the PDF render failed. BLOCKED: delete. These subcommands are refused and calling one returns an error. Do not attempt them.
